LEN@r.t: Lennar's fiscal Q3 missed on both lines, with the feed showing adjusted EPS of $1.23 against the $1.28 consensus and revenue of about $8.0B versus the $8.32B estimate. On a reported basis net earnings fell 52% to $284M, or $1.19 per diluted share, from $591M and $2.29 a year earlier, and the homebuilder lowered its annual delivery target. RML.t: Resolution Minerals is listed in the feed for September 24, but no consensus EPS or revenue figures are published and the reporting time is unconfirmed, so treat the date as a placeholder. Drill results, funding and project timelines are what matter here.
